declaration: BOOL xxx_Open( DWORD dwData, DWORD dwAccess, DWORD dwShareMode );

evidence.detail: declaration, requirements block, parameter list read mechanically from the page

parameters.description: Specifies the value returned by xxx_Init for the given service instance.
parameters.name: dwData

parameters.description: Specifies the type of access to the object. An application can obtain read, write, read-write, or device query access. This parameter can be any combination of the following values. Value Description GENERIC_READ Specifies read access to the object. Data can be read from a file and the file pointer can be moved. It can be combined with GENERIC_WRITE to create read-write access. GENERIC_WRITE Specifies write access to the object. Data can be written to the file and the file pointer can be moved. It can be combined with GENERIC_READ for read-write access.

documented_values.description: Specifies read access to the object. Data can be read from a file and the file pointer can be moved. It can be combined with GENERIC_WRITE to create read-write access.
Specifies write access to the object. Data can be written to the file and the file pointer can be moved. It can be combined with GENERIC_READ for read-write access.

parameters.name: dwAccess

parameters.description: Specifies how the object can be shared. If dwShareMode is zero, than the object cannot be shared. Subsequent open operation on the object will fail, until the handle is closed. To share the object, use a combination of one or more of the following values. Value Description FILE_SHARE_READ Subsequent open operations on the object will succeed only if read access is requested. FILE_SHARE_WRITE Subsequent open operations on the object will succeed only if write access is requested.

documented_values.description: Subsequent open operations on the object will succeed only if read access is requested.
Subsequent open operations on the object will succeed only if write access is requested.
